property_summary: For any call to fallback that sends exactly 10 ether and occurs at a strictly later timestamp, the reference C never drains its entire balance unless the current block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant inverts this condition and will drain on some block numbers where block.number % 15 != 0, so there exist fuzzed block numbers that make address(c).balance differ (zero vs non-zero) after the call.
change_summary: Change payout condition to trigger when block.number % 15 != 0 so withdrawal occurs on different blocks.
